messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: P1 - az-east-2a network flap + model-serving errors (route: /v1/embeddings). Alert id=PD-987654. Automated routing check recommended failover.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page sent to primary oncall (ryan.c). Escalation policy: 5m -> team lead.

ryan.c: ack - oncall here, taking lead. Pulling logs + routing table.

maria.ops: joining — seeing 502/504 spikes from proxy in az-east-2a. Customers reporting embedding latency/timeouts.

kevin-sre: metrics: 502-rate 18% in last 5m for az-east-2a, kv-cache miss rate jumped x6, network retransmits high. No full node OOMs.

kevin-sre: logs snippet (from az-east-2a ingress):
```
2026-04-12T10:12:03Z proxy[ingress-07]: upstream_reset: connection-reset-by-peer id=svc-model-03
2026-04-12T10:12:04Z runtime[model-03]: KVSHARD lookup timeout 1500ms shard=14
2026-04-12T10:12:05Z proxy[ingress-09]: downstream 504 for /v1/embeddings token=abcd
```

tilly-oncall: I can start traffic shift to az-east-2b and enable routing fallback for embedding routes. Suggest: 1) enable region fallback 2) enable low-cost-quantized fallback model for degraded requests 3) scale dedicated pool in az-east-2b.

ryan.c: do it. Keep the canary small (5% -> 30%). Notify customers.

maria.ops: running failover command now:
```
# runbook command (internal)
redwoodctl routing set-policy --route "/v1/embeddings" --fallback az-east-2b --weight 0.05
redwoodctl model rollout --route "/v1/embeddings" --fallback-model redwood-embed-small-quantized --max-traffic 0.05
```

incident-bot: Routing policy change applied: /v1/embeddings fallback -> az-east-2b (5%). Model fallback redwood-embed-small-quantized (5%).

kevin-sre: checking metrics after 2m: error rate in az-east-2a still elevated but total customer 5xx count decreased ~40% after 5% shift. Starting progressive ramp to 30% while monitoring.

ryan.c: ramping to 30% now. Watch latency and correctness. If model fallback accuracy drops, auto-failback.

customer-success-bot: Notifying CS on impacted accounts (top 10 heavy embedding users) — draft message ready for approval.

maria.ops: running autoscaler tweak for az-east-2b GPU pool: increase min-replicas from 6 -> 12; command queued to autoscaler.

kevin-sre: observation: KV cache errors appear correlated with a subset of top-of-rack switches in az-east-2a; network team opening ticket with cloud provider. We should evacuate pods from nodes on those racks.

tilly-oncall: initiating drain for affected nodes in az-east-2a:
```
kubectl cordon node rack-a-12 && kubectl drain node rack-a-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# repeat for rack-a-13, rack-a-14
```

incident-bot: Node drain tasks started. Autoscaler will replace with nodes in healthy racks if capacity needed.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: alert escalated to SRE leads after 8m without full resolution. Oncall handoff: next person will take watch in 25m.

ryan.c: summary of impact so far: ~7k failed embedding requests in last 10m (approx 12% of global embedding traffic) concentrated in az-east-2a. Not seeing data exfiltration signs. Customer-facing latency 500-1500ms higher for fallback traffic.

maria.ops: status page draft: <https://status.redwood.ai|https://status.redwood.ai> -> "We are investigating increased errors and latency for embeddings in az-east-2. Traffic is being routed to healthy regions; mitigation in progress." Please approve. :warning:

ryan.c: approved. CS bot send.

customer-success-bot: Sent message to impacted customers and opened support escalations for top 3. Template used: "We're experiencing increased errors for embeddings in az-east-2; we've activated regional failover and are working on a permanent fix. We'll keep you updated."

kevin-sre: cloud provider says they've detected intermittent topology flap in top-of-rack switches; they're moving traffic and investigating hardware. Expected 60-90m for hardware replacement. We'll keep fallback routing until provider confirms stable.

tilly-oncall: set auto-fallback-policy: if fallback model returns >3% quality regression we will cut to 10% and notify. For now keep 30% traffic.

ryan.c: action items before handoff: 1) continue ramp at 30% for 15m 2) monitor QA signals for fallback model 3) confirm drains completed 4) maintain status page updates every 15m 5) post-incident notify infra providers.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: next oncall in 25m is kevin-sre. Handing off.

kevin-sre: acked. Taking over monitoring and liaison with cloud provider.

maria.ops: leaving short note — logs & metric snapshots saved to incident runbook.

ryan.c: thanks all — excellent coordination. We'll convert to a full incident ticket and schedule a postmortem once mitigations complete.

incident-bot: Incident runbook entry created: ID=INC-2026-04012-az-east-network.

kevin-sre: quick customer impact estimate to include in incident ticket: ~0.5% of total platform requests affected overall, but embeddings customers saw 12% error rate during window. Approx 3k unique customers had at least one failure.

ryan.c: noted. I'll draft postmortem outline after stabilization. If anything changes, ping with @here. :white_check_mark:
